regions.full_page: Robert Molloy - 25 - Dying a yr ago last February ... lingered on back. Enrolled June 21st and prayed for here at these devotions - August 10th last year was improving - in fact trying to learn to walk again. To- day is reported back home in Ireland from Glasgo Scotland practically, Okay - Expects to go back to work in September. Deo Gr.
